feats.title: Kobold in a Corner
feats.description: You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls against creatures that have combat advantage against you. This bonus increases to +2 at 11th level and +3 at 21st level.

feats.title: Strength in Numbers
feats.description: You gain a bonus to melee rolls against a target equal to the number of allies adjacent to it.

feats.title: Trap Safety
feats.description: A trap will never accidentally trigger while you fail a Skill Check to disarm it.

feats.title: Group Sneak
feats.description: Allies within 5 squares of you have a +2 on Skill Checks to sneak or hide.
